title: Spacious 4BR 30A Vacation Home with Beach Access
meta_description: Stay in this spacious 4BR, 3.5BA, 30A three-story vacation home, located near Hogtown Bayou, Choctawhatchee Bay, with beach access. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: Harmony by the Bay: Your Perfect Family Retreat Near Outdoor AdventuresLooking for a modern and spacious home perfect for a family vacation or group getaway? This stunning three-story house provides the ideal backdrop for creating lasting memories. Conveniently located for quick access to Hogtown Bayou and Choctawhatchee Bay, you can dive into exciting fishing and boating adventures immediately!! With 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, this home comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests. Plus, the nearby boat launch is literally a walk across the street, , making it easy to kick off your outdoor escapades.Inside, you'll find a spacious open kitchen and living area equipped with a 90” TV that connects to a large deck with seating for 15 and another 80” TV, creating an inviting space for relaxation and entertainment. The fully equipped kitchen is a chef’s delight, featuring an espresso machine, Breville coffee maker, Keurig, toaster, and a refrigerator with an ice maker. For dining, a long table with seating for 10 is complemented by an additional 8 chairs in the eat-in kitchen. Step outside to the expansive deck, where a large table for 8 awaits, along with a grill for enjoyable barbecues against the backdrop of lush greenery. After a day of fun, unwind on the deck area, complete with comfortable seating and a TV, perfect for movie nights under the stars.The property also boasts a large rear lawn, ideal for outdoor games or simply soaking up the sun, along with a shaded under-deck seating area for relaxation. When you’re ready for some beach time, the beautiful 30A beaches are just a quick 10-minute drive away, allowing you to enjoy both the bay and the coast.Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: 1 King bed, 80” TV, sofa, crib and a private bathroom with double vanitiesBedroom 2: 2 Bunk beds (Twin over full Full over twin),70” TV and a private combination tub/shower bathroomBedroom 3: 1 King bed, 70” TV and a private half bathroomBedroom 4: 1 King bed, 70” TV, sofa and a private combination tub/shower bathroomBay Access:Walk across the street to Cessna Landing. (literally right across the street!!)Distance: .1 miles | Time: 1 minute walking, 1 minute drivingBeach Access:Turn left onto N County Hwy 393 and go straight to beach access !!Distance: 3.6 miles | Time: 10 minutes drivingCessna Landing:Cessna Landing is a county park on Highway 393 a few miles north of US 98 on Hogtown Bayou. (literally across the street) The park has a boat launch, docks, picnic shelters, full court basketball court, squash court, and playground. Right next door is the Bayou Arts Center, home to the Cultural Arts Alliance of Walton County. Some of the charter boats and pontoons going to Crab Island pick up at the docks here. Also see the best sunsets on the bay here !!Your stay at Harmony by the Bay comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Golf carts not permitted.* Parking for 4 cars.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
